Shortened version of the Script
Hi Thank you for picking up my call I'M XXXXX from symbiosis. I am calling you from Symbiosis on behalf of my CEO, Arun to see if we can help your practice. 

We are a practice in a box and we have been helping clinics like yours achieve significant revenue growth. We are a one stop shop for all things operations. We help manage FO/BO, credentialing billing, RCM management, marketing, all things that generally cause operational headaches for clinics.

One of our strengths is workflow management where we monitor to make sure nothing slips through the cracks. Our mission is to reduce your operational stress and increase revenue. We have helped a lot of clinics and I called up to check if we can provide the same services for you as well. 


Script for clinics who have posted jobs
Hi, Thank you for picking up my call I'M XXXXX from symbiosis. I am calling you from Symbiosis on behalf of my CEO, Arun to see if we can help your practice. 

We are a practice in a box and we have been helping clinics like yours who are growing but need help with managing that growth. We have seen plenty of clinics who grow too fast without good processes and come crashing down. Our job is to help you with that process. We are a one stop shop for all things operations. We help manage FO/BO, credentialing billing, RCM management, marketing, all things that generally cause operational headaches for clinics.

One of our strengths is workflow management where we monitor to make sure nothing slips through the cracks. In fact, we can conduct an audit for your current operations and if everything appears satisfactory you can rest assured that you are doing everything right. But if we do find any gaps we can help with those. 

Our mission is to reduce your operational stress and increase revenue. We have helped a lot of clinics and I called up to check if we can provide the same services for you as well. 


Introduction 
Hi John, thank you for taking my call. I’m Ronny from Symbiosis. How are you doing today?  

We help clinics like yours achieve significant revenue growth while increasing operational efficiency. We understand the pain of running a practice and we want to take that pain away from you. For e.g the basic premise for a clinic to be successful is to one, bring in new patients, treat them and then have those treatments generate revenue. If there are process inefficiencies in any of these three then the clinic is losing money. 

DO NOT SAY WE REDUCE COSTS, KEEP THE TOPIC ON REDUCING HEADACHES FROM INEFFICIENCIES AND INCREASE REVENUE. 

Our mission boils down to two things, reduce operational stress and increase revenue. We want you to work on your business, not in your business. We provide a ONE STOP SHOP for all things operations. We provide operational support so you can focus on patient care. We can manage front office, back office, credentialing and billing, digital marketing and even clinic space.

For instance, Capital Physical Therapy and District Speech have seen remarkable improvements. We brought in operations workflow management into their clinics, which essentially ensures nothing falls through the cracks. Would you be interested in learning how we can assist your clinic similarly?   


If client says yes, 
Fantastic! We’ve partnered with around 100 clinics, helping them increase their monthly revenue by 10-15% just by streamlining work.. Additionally, we've uncovered up to $500,000 in unclaimed revenue, money that they weren't even aware of. Let’s explore how we can achieve similar results for your clinic.  This might sound too good to be true but we have clinics that can back up what I just said. Arun, our CEO can talk to you and give you more information. 
 
To provide you with the most relevant solutions, would you mind answering few questions 
For established clinics: 
Confirm if they have X providers in their clinic
Do you participate in insurance? 
What insurances do you participate in?(Optional)
What billingsolution are you currently using? 
How do you manage patient intake 
Are you facing any challenges with insurance reimbursements?or with claims management in general?
How are you managing front desk work? We have seen issues ranging from front desk person quitting, training, to finding the right person for the job.
How busy is your clinic? Do you feel the need to get more patients in?
 
 
Based on their responses, present tailored solutions: 

For Administrative Support: “We handle all administrative tasks such as appointment scheduling, patient registration, verification of insurances and workflow management, so you can focus on clinical duties without the administrative headache.” 
For Revenue Management: “Effective revenue management is crucial, especially for a  practice to be able to grow. We manage credentialing, billing and coding, ensure timely reimbursements, claim follow ups and help oversee your finances to maximize profitability and sustainability.” 

For Technology Integration: “In today’s digital age, having the right technology is essential. We support state-of-the-art EHR systems, provide telemedicine solutions, and data analytics to enhance your practice’s efficiency and patient care.” 
Closing: “I’d love to show you how our solutions work in more detail. Would you be available for a [demo/meeting] sometime this week? It typically takes about 30 mins and can provide a clear picture of how we can assist your practice.” 
If client is interested:

Stress-Free Life: We manage the process of running your practice, so you can focus on patient care. 
Financial Stability: Expert billing and RCM management to grow your practice. 
Enhanced Operations: Advanced technology solutions that improve patient satisfaction and streamline operations.”
